pipeline.batch4_email_first_2026-09-16: Batch 4 was EMAIL-FIRST: the 5 entries in no_site_prospects.json that carry an email. Live-verified each for (a) exists at that city/phone, (b) no first-party website, (c) operating within 12 months, (d) email provenance. Only 1 of 5 survived. DROPPED with evidence: Tint Pros / Platinum Auto Wraps ('Albuquerque', 763-312-6137) is actually 7703 Central Ave NE, Minneapolis/Spring Lake Park, MN (BBB profile, about.me; 763 is a Minnesota area code) and HAS a live site, tintprosmobile.com -- the source sweep geocoded a Minneapolis street address onto Albuquerque; Car Shack Performance ('San Antonio', phone '6971470', ramon.carshack@gmail.com) is at 7461 Bagtikan St, San Antonio Village, MAKATI, Philippines (lat 14.56 / lon 121.01; carshackperformance.com, est. 1986, owner Ramon Villacorta) -- the sweep's city filter matched the Makati barangay named San Antonio, same failure as Muflas J C (Costa Rica) and Montero Auto Enhancer (Makati); Top Notch Tints (Denver, 720-347-3255) HAS a live first-party site, topnotchtintsllc.com, carrying that exact phone and topnotchtintsllc@gmail.com; Panther Performance Auto Group (Denver, 303-974-5813) is CLOSED: Yelp shows a 'this location has closed' banner, no reviews newer than 2018, and 3011 W 49th Ave is now occupied by unrelated shops (a Yelp 'Updated <month>' label in a page title is NOT operating evidence -- it can sit on a closed listing). Lessons for the sweep: (1) any prospect whose lat/lon falls outside the US is junk regardless of the city string -- add a bounding-box check; (2) phone area code must be consistent with the state (763 vs NM, 916 vs CA) before a row is trusted; (3) directly fetch the candidate's likely domains (name.com, namellc.com) -- two of five 'no website' rows had one.
